user.title: Home EMS
user.description: Choose the entities Home EMS reads. Version 0.1 runs in observation mode and never changes your devices.

data.heat_pump_power: Heat pump electrical power (one or more sensors)
data.battery_power: Battery power (one or more sensors, optional)
data.heat_output: Heat pump heat output (optional; learns COP and heat per outdoor temperature)

reconfigure.title: Home EMS: change entities
reconfigure.description: Choose other entities, for example the thermostat entity Home EMS writes to. The options stay as they are.

data.heat_pump_power: Heat pump electrical power (one or more sensors)
data.battery_power: Battery power (one or more sensors, optional)
data.heat_output: Heat pump heat output (optional; learns COP and heat per outdoor temperature)

advised_run_minutes_today.name: Advised run minutes today (heat pump off)

own_use_year.name: Own use of solar this year

planner.title: Planner and advice
planner.description: Home EMS decides when the heat pump runs and writes the living room setpoint (with the control switch on). Between runs the setpoint is the minimum minus the off margin, so tado does nothing by itself; a run starts just above the room and stops at the top. Open a section to change it.

temperatures.name: Temperatures by day
temperatures.description: Lower and upper limit of the living room during the day.

data.run_headroom_k: Run ceiling above the comfort setpoint

data_description.comfort_setpoint: Lower limit by day: at this temperature (+0.1) Home EMS starts a run itself. Also the target of the planner.
data_description.run_headroom_k: Top of a run by day = comfort setpoint + this. At the top the run stops at once. 0.5 gives long runs (e.g. 19.0 to 19.5).
data_description.comfort_max: Top of a run on solar surplus or at a low price: heat stored in the house. Also the highest setpoint Home EMS ever writes.
data_description.comfort_min: Safety limit: below this in the living room or the kitchen a run always starts, also at night and in a price peak.
data_description.off_margin_k: Setpoint between runs = minimum − this (by day the comfort setpoint, at night the night minimum). tado then only heats by itself as a safety net when Home EMS or Home Assistant is down.

night.name: Night
night.description: During the night window the house may cool down.

data_description.living_min: Lower limit at night: at this temperature (+0.1) Home EMS starts a run.
data_description.night_ceiling: Top of a run at night (never below the comfort minimum; a run always climbs at least the start band). 0 = night minimum + start band.
data_description.night_end: End of the night window: from here the day limits apply. Set it an hour or so before you get up, so the house is warm in time.

runs.name: Runs
runs.description: How long runs and pauses are.

data_description.min_run_minutes: A run that has started goes on at least this long, also past the top. 30 to 90 minutes avoids short cycling.
data_description.start_band_k: A planned run only starts while the room is at least this far below the top, so it has room to climb and lasts long.
data_description.min_pause_hours: Planner: pauses shorter than this are filled, so planned runs merge into one long run.
data_description.max_gap_hours: Planner: a safety net that plans a run when there has been none for this long.

solar_price.name: Solar and price
solar_price.description: Using solar surplus and cheap hours.

data_description.pv_run_threshold_w: A run starts on solar when the 5-minute average surplus is at least this and the forecast for the coming hour still gives a surplus.
data_description.boost_margin_w: During a run the gap goes up 0.1 per 5 minutes while the average export is above this, and halves when the average import is above it. 0 = off.
data_description.gap_max_k: Largest gap on solar or at a low price. A larger gap lets the heat pump run harder.
data_description.low_price_eur: At or below this all-in price per kWh the gap is the largest and the top is the comfort maximum. 0 = off.
data_description.expensive_share_pct: The most expensive share of the quarters of the day counts as a price peak: the advice starts no run there (the minimums still do), and a run does not run on to the top.
data_description.dynamic_from: First day of a contract with a price per quarter. Before this date the price does not matter (fixed tariff): no price peak, no low price boost, and the planner plans on the COP only (the warmest hours). Empty = prices count.

data.floor_rule_band: Floor rule only below comfort setpoint +

data_description.floor_rule_band: The floor rule only starts a run while the living room is below the comfort setpoint plus this.
data_description.floor_min_margin: Floor water minus living room below this: run (while the floor pump circulates).

house_model.name: House and heat pump (planner)
house_model.description: The planner uses these to estimate how many run-hours are needed.

data.heat_rate_slope: Heat per run-hour: less per °C warmer

data_description.heat_rate_kw: Heat the heat pump delivers while it runs, at 0 °C outside (measured Quatt Duo: about 7.0 kW).
data_description.heat_rate_slope: How much less heat per degree warmer outside (measured: about 0.4 kW per °C). 0 = the same at every temperature.
data_description.capacity_kwh_k: Heat stored per degree room temperature. A room above the target lowers the need, a room below it raises it.
data_description.base_load_kw: Use of the house besides the heat pump, for the solar forecast.

sources.name: Sources
sources.description: Sensors for prices, solar and weather.

data_description.solar_entity: Jeroen.nl solar forecast for today, attribute hours.
data_description.gas_price_entity: Jeroen.nl gas price, all-in per m³ (hybrid: the boiler where it is cheaper).

control.title: Control
control.description: Home EMS writes its target setpoint to the living room thermostat while the switch 'Control (write setpoint)' is on (off by default). Turn off the existing heat pump automations and the kitchen setpoint first, so only one party steers the thermostat.

data.override_hours: Pause after a setpoint changed by hand
data.write_step_k: Smallest change to write (start and stop are always written)

bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Radiator thermostats in the bedrooms only open a valve; warm water flows while the living room asks for heat. Home EMS opens them during runs in the evening window before bedtime, and asks for a short run shortly before bedtime if a room is still too cold. Shadow mode: nothing is written.

pv_appliances.title: PV curtailment and appliances
pv_appliances.description: Shadow mode. Curtailment: at a negative market price Home EMS shows which inverter it would switch off (each behind its own switch), only when that inverter delivers less than the export. Appliances: the cheapest start before the ready-by time, from the price and solar forecast.

data.pv_power_entities: Live power per inverter (W, one sensor each)

battery_reserve.title: Battery reserve
battery_reserve.description: Some batteries power their backup socket from the battery itself, also while the grid is there. Home EMS charges such a battery from the grid before it runs empty, while the switch 'Battery reserve' is on (off by default): at or below the start level, until the stop level, only while the grid meter gives values. The battery is set to external control and forced charge, and afterwards back to standby and its own control. Leave the other battery out of 'hold', or it discharges into this one.

data.reserve_soc_entity: State of charge of the backup battery (%)
data.reserve_external_control: Switch: external control (e.g. RS485 control mode)
data.reserve_charge_to_entity: Number: charge to state of charge (optional; the battery then stops by itself)
data.reserve_grid_sensors: Grid meter sensors that must give values (empty: the grid power sensor)
data.reserve_hold_entities: Numbers set to 0 while charging and restored afterwards (e.g. max discharge of the other battery)
data.reserve_charge_option: Option of the forced mode that charges
data.reserve_standby_option: Option of the forced mode that stops

overview.title: Energy and cost overview
overview.description: Choose the long-term statistics (the same as in the Energy dashboard) and enter contracts and advance payments as YAML. Home EMS builds a monthly overview with a forecast for the rest of the year and, if a folder is given, writes it as CSV (semicolon, decimal comma) every hour.

data.cost_settings: Contracts, advances, wallbox refund, cashback, hand-entered periods (YAML)

error.invalid_cost_settings: The cost settings are not valid YAML or miss a field (each contract needs at least 'vanaf').
error.invalid_bedrooms: The rooms are not valid YAML, or a room misses 'entiteit' (a climate entity).
error.invalid_appliances: The appliances are not valid YAML, or an appliance misses 'naam'.
error.reserve_band: The stop level must be at least 2% above the start level.
